verdict.rationale: Raygun documents an error chart showing error frequency and trends, deployment tracking to spot new errors or regressions, and prioritizing and filtering errors by occurrences and version within the Crash Reporting dashboard. That covers volume over time and per-release regressions within an application. There is no evidence of leadership dashboards that aggregate trends across multiple projects or teams. Missing for 10: cross-project/team aggregated dashboards, an explicit 'new issues per release' dashboard view, a top-regressions ranking widget, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineering leader, I can see error trends across projects and teams on dashboards — top regressions, new issues per release, volume over time

citations.quote: Added **error chart** visualization to **search results page**. Provides visual insight into error frequency and trends.
Track every deployment in real time to identify any new errors or regressions.
Order and prioritize errors based on users affected and the number of occurrences, and use smart filters to segment errors by date, location, version, host, OS, browser, and custom tags.
